title: Vampire Hunter D
justification: Checked by title. The film is TMDB movie 9463 (Vampire Hunter D (1985)). The node moves from TVDB 79042 to the OVA marker. TVDB series 79042 no longer exists. TheTVDB carries this release only as movie 7517 (Vampire Hunter D, 1985-12-21), with the node's IMDb id tt0090248 and TMDB 9463. AniDB types it an OVA, so the marker is OVA; AniDB episodes 2-3 are its two parts.
